data: Which of the following morphs has longer bar than 'plural -s' bar??

The question asks which morph has a longer bar than the 'plural -s' bar. From the analysis of the figure, we can see that the bars represent the average morphological complexity of different morphs. The 'plural -s' bar is the second shortest bar in the chart. Comparing all other bars with this one, we find that the '3rd ps sg -s' bar extends further to the right, indicating a higher average morphological complexity and thus a longer bar. Therefore, the morph with a longer bar than the 'plural -s' bar is '3rd ps sg -s'.
